name: 95618 · Davis, CA
findings: ZIP 95618 (Davis) has 114 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 49 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95618 (Davis) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
